Each was compared value by value with that extraction (App. 7.2 table; variable O&M with the App. 7.3 sheets to their printed precision; efficiency = 1/fuel input per unit output). Reproduced values are NOT in the main file but listed in _other-values as "reproduces element-energy_2018_001"; unexplained differences as "differs ..., unjustified; original used"; differences with a stated reason (plasma cement kiln 262+125, CHP electric boiler 2/3 scaling, HYBRIT/H2-DR "assumed cost of glass furnace", counterfactual lifetimes "updated from stakeholder engagement") are in the main file with the reason. For IFS-cited rows the main file keeps only N-ZIP's own values (year of availability; variable opex where IFS prints none). PRICE YEAR: capture and compressor costs are 2019 GBP (CINDY 2013 GBP x ONS CPI 1.0978, Technology Data!BG30:BG33; the guide p.45 wrongly says "110% increase"); no price year is stated for any other block, so 2021 is used and flagged (IFS-derived numbers are unconverted IFS figures). CAPACITY BASIS: the guide (p.40) defines N-ZIP reference sizes as "MW final energy consumption", so GBP/kW is per kW of fuel or electricity input (thermal-input / electric-input), not of heat output.
